_comment: User-editable notes. Field keys are <TableBase>.<Field> (or <TableFamily>.<Field> to cover DamageDataTable1..5 at once, e.g. DamageDataTable.Damage). Enum keys are member docs shown in dropdowns. Also editable from the app's Inspector (click the book icon on any field).

fields.DamageDataTable.ID: Row ID. Unique across the whole DamageDataTable1..5 family (the patcher adds rows by name). Prefix matches the owner: CP_010_* = Yuji, CN_* = NPC/boss.
fields.DamageDataTable.AttackType: Which attack class this hit belongs to. Used for scaling buckets, adaptation and log/voice routing. NormalAttack = standard chain; CursedEnergyAttack_1/2 = skill slots; SuperCursedEnergyAttack = ultimate.
fields.DamageDataTable.Damage: Base HP damage of one connect, before guard/combo/armor scaling. 0 = no HP damage (utility / setup hit). Jabs sit around 5-15, skills much higher.
fields.DamageDataTable.Ally_DamageRate: Friendly-fire multiplier for this hit. 0 = cannot hurt allies (the vanilla default); 1 = full damage to allies.
fields.DamageDataTable.CN_240_DamageRate: Damage multiplier applied only when the receiver is CN_240. Boss/adaptation tuning knob; 1 = no change.
fields.DamageDataTable.Armor_Damage: Damage dealt to the victim's armor gauge (super/hyper-armor pool), not to HP. High values break through armored moves faster.
fields.DamageDataTable.Down_Damage: Knockdown-meter damage. The victim crumples when their meter (usually 1000, see CharacterBaseParameter.DownValue) fills. Jabs deal ~200, finishers far more.
fields.DamageDataTable.GuardDurability_Damage: Guard-meter damage on block. Vanilla guard has ~150 durability, so a 15-damage jab takes ~10 blocked hits to guard-break.
fields.DamageDataTable.Destructible_Attack: Damage dealt to stage destructibles. 0 = cannot break objects.
fields.DamageDataTable.CursedEnergyExp_Add_Atta: Cursed-energy XP granted to the attacker on hit (feeds the LevelThreshold ladder). A jab grants ~12.
fields.DamageDataTable.CursedEnergyExp_Add_Rece: Cursed-energy XP granted to the victim when hit. Usually 0; raise to reward trading hits.
fields.DamageDataTable.CursedEnergy_Add_Attacke: Flat cursed-energy gauge gained by the attacker on hit. Separate from XP/levels.
fields.DamageDataTable.TensionGauge_Add_Attacke: Momentum/awakening gauge gained by the attacker on hit. 0 = none.
fields.DamageDataTable.HitSlow_Attacker: Hitstop strength on the attacker: time-scale applied while the hit lands (1 = no slow, lower = heavier freeze). 0 disables it.
fields.DamageDataTable.HitSlow_Time_Attacker: How long (seconds) the attacker's hitstop lasts.
fields.DamageDataTable.HitSlow_Guard_Attacker: Hitstop strength on the attacker when the hit is blocked. Lets blocked heavies feel weightier than blocked jabs.
fields.DamageDataTable.HitSlow_Time_Guard_Attac: Duration (seconds) of the attacker's on-block hitstop.
fields.DamageDataTable.HitSlow_Receiver: Hitstop strength on the victim. Higher freeze sells heavy hits; keep jabs snappy.
fields.DamageDataTable.HitSlow_Time_Receiver: How long (seconds) the victim's hitstop lasts.
fields.DamageDataTable.HitSlow_Guard_Receiver: Hitstop strength on a blocking victim. This is most of what makes blocked hits feel solid.
fields.DamageDataTable.HitInterval: Seconds between damage ticks for multi-hit volumes. 0 = single application.
fields.DamageDataTable.HitMax: Max times this hit volume can connect. 0 = hits once; raise for lingering multi-hit (paired with HitInterval).
fields.DamageDataTable.bHitOnce: True = each target can be hit only once per spawned instance (anti-vacuum/anti-rehit guard). False lets lingering volumes re-hit.
fields.DamageDataTable.Knockback_Damage: Launch strength applied to the victim on a clean hit (Unreal velocity-ish units). ~80 is a firm launch; 0 = victim stays planted.
fields.DamageDataTable.Knockback_Damage_Time: How long (seconds) the on-hit knockback velocity persists. Small values like 0.1 give a sharp pop.
fields.DamageDataTable.Knockback_Guard: Pushback applied to a blocking victim. This is what shoves guards across the stage.
fields.DamageDataTable.Guard_Rigidity_Time: Blockstun: seconds the blocker is locked after guarding this hit. Longer values make pressure safe.
fields.DamageDataTable.bCasualDamageActionCorre: True = this hit uses the casual/cinematic damage-reaction correction (softer reactions for cutscene-ish hits).
fields.DamageDataTable.bCancelCasualDamageActio: True = cancels an active casual-reaction correction on the victim (returns them to normal reactions).
fields.DamageDataTable.bAutoHomingZDisabled: True = disables vertical (Z) auto-homing for this hit, so it will not bend up/down toward airborne targets.
fields.DamageDataTable.bNullifiesCursedTechniqu: True = this hit nullifies/ignores the victim's active cursed-technique effects (e.g. neutralizes adaptation-adjacent defenses).
fields.DamageDataTable.bIgnoreGuard: True = unblockable. Ignores guard entirely (see also AttackDataTable.AttackAvoidType for the attacker-side flag).
fields.DamageDataTable.bIgnoreSuperArmor: True = beats super armor (victim still takes the reaction instead of armoring through).
fields.DamageDataTable.bUnkillable: True = this hit can never KO; the victim survives at 1 HP. Used for scripted/system hits.
fields.DamageDataTable.bIgnoreComboCorrect: True = skips combo damage scaling (full damage even deep in a combo). Enable sparingly or infinites get out of hand.
fields.DamageDataTable.bIgnoreDamageActionCorre: True = skips the damage-reaction correction (victim plays the raw reaction).
fields.DamageDataTable.DamageType: Hit reaction the victim plays: Normal/Down/Blow tiers plus special restraints (stuns, grabs, tag states). This decides knockdown vs juggle vs pin.
fields.DamageDataTable.bBoundEnabled: True = this hit can ground-bounce / wall-bounce the victim for combo extensions.
fields.DamageDataTable.DamageKind: Hitbox class: Melee (strike), Projectile (detached effect with its own life), Throwing (grab-like). Affects interactions and immunities.
fields.DamageDataTable.DamageAdaptType: Which Mahoraga-style adaptation bucket this hit feeds. None = never adapts; otherwise the receiver builds resistance to that slot.
fields.DamageDataTable.DamageDirectionType: Reference frame for the launch direction: attacker-facing, receiver-facing, line between them, actor, or movement direction.
fields.DamageDataTable.DamageDirectionAdjustPit: Vertical aim tweak (degrees) added to the launch direction. 20 pops victims slightly upward.
fields.DamageDataTable.DamageDirectionAdjustYaw: Horizontal aim tweak (degrees). 180 sends the victim the opposite way (behind the attacker).
fields.DamageDataTable.bIgnoreDamageDirectionPi: True = keep the launch flat and ignore the pitch adjustment above.
fields.DamageDataTable.GuardDirectionAdjustYaw: Horizontal facing tweak applied to a blocking victim (degrees). Usually 0.
fields.DamageDataTable.GuardLookAtDirectionAdju: How far the blocker turns toward the attacker (degrees). Usually 0.
fields.DamageDataTable.DamageSpeed_Start: Victim fly-away speed at launch (Unreal units/sec). ~3000 is a hard launch.
fields.DamageDataTable.DamageSpeed_End: Fly-away speed it eases toward by the end of the interpolate window. Lower = victim decelerates mid-flight.
fields.DamageDataTable.DamageSpeed_InterpolateT: Seconds over which launch speed blends from Start to End. 0 = snaps instantly.
fields.DamageDataTable.DamageSpeed_EasingType: Curve used for the launch-speed blend (None = linear; EaseIn/Out/InOut shape the arc).
fields.DamageDataTable.DamageSpeed_Blend_Exp: Exponent shaping the launch-speed blend (~2 is the vanilla default; higher = snappier early change).
fields.DamageDataTable.DamageGravity: Extra gravity applied to the launched victim. 0 = default arc; raise to slam victims down faster.
fields.DamageDataTable.RestraintTime: Seconds a restraint-type hit (DamageType pin/grab) holds the victim. 0 = momentary reaction only.
fields.DamageDataTable.HitTargetType: Who this hit can touch: EnemyOnly, AllyOnly, or All. Utility/heal hits use the non-default values.
fields.DamageDataTable.Id_Effect_Hit: Hit spark/effect row (EffectDataTable) spawned on connect. None = no effect.
fields.DamageDataTable.Id_Effect_Destructible_H: Effect spawned when this hit smashes a stage object. None = reuse the normal hit effect (or nothing).
fields.DamageDataTable.HitEffectLocationType: Where the hit effect spawns: at the impact point, on the receiver, or on the struck component.
fields.DamageDataTable.HitEffectDirection: Which way the hit effect faces: along the hit normal, movement, attacker, or actor direction.
fields.DamageDataTable.HitEffectRotation: Extra pitch/yaw/roll (degrees) applied to the spawned hit effect.
fields.DamageDataTable.SoundEffectPitchOffset: Pitch shift added to the impact sound (semitone-ish). 0 = as-authored; small offsets vary repeat hits.
fields.DamageDataTable.GroundBoundEffectScale: Scale multiplier for the ground-bounce effect. 1 = normal size.
fields.DamageDataTable.Id_GroundBoundDecal: Decal stamped on a ground bounce (scorch/crack mark). None = no decal.
fields.DamageDataTable.GroundBoundDecalScale: Size multiplier for the ground-bounce decal. 1 = normal.
fields.DamageDataTable.DamageVoiceType: Victim grunt tier for this hit (None/Weak/Medium/Heavy/Blow). Match it to the damage or light hits will scream like finishers.
fields.DamageDataTable.SpecialDamageVoiceType: Special-case victim voice (executions, counters). None = use the normal DamageVoiceType.
fields.DamageDataTable.Id_CameraShake_Attacker: Camera shake(s) played for the attacker. Two slots (main + secondary); None entries do nothing.
fields.DamageDataTable.Id_CameraShake_Receiver: Camera shake(s) played for the victim. Two slots; typically the big blow shake lives here.
fields.DamageDataTable.Id_ForceFeedback_Attacke: Controller rumble played for the attacker. None = no rumble.
fields.DamageDataTable.Id_ForceFeedback_Receive: Controller rumble played for the victim.
fields.DamageDataTable.Id_CollisionModify: Collision-modifier row adjusting this hit's volume (size/priority tweaks). None = default collision.
fields.DamageDataTable.bGuardBuffDebuffAddEnabl: True = buff/debuff application also fires when the hit is guarded (not only on clean hit).
fields.DamageDataTable.Id_BuffDebuff_Add: Status rows applied on hit. Two slots; None = empty slot.
fields.DamageDataTable.Id_BuffDebuff_Remove: Status rows cleansed on hit. Two slots; None = empty slot.
fields.AttackDataTable.ID: Row ID. Unique across AttackDataTable1..5. The bridge between Action/AttackSet entries and Damage rows: an Attack row says HOW the move animates and cancels, Damage rows say WHAT it does on contact.
fields.AttackDataTable.Id_ActionHoming: Movement/homing row (ActionHomingDataTable) steering the attacker during this move. None = plant feet and swing in place.
fields.AttackDataTable.Id_CancelAttackActionHom: Homing override used when this move is reached via cancel. Lets cancelled versions track differently from raw ones.
fields.AttackDataTable.CharacterAnimation: Body animation montage played for this attack (e.g. AttackA_01_01). Must exist in the character's animation set or the move T-poses.
fields.AttackDataTable.WeaponAnimation: Weapon/prop animation. None = no weapon anim (fists, or the body anim already covers it).
fields.AttackDataTable.AttackTransitionType: Cancel rule for this move: whether follow-ups trigger on input vs on hit, and whether guard/just-guard still allow the cancel. Auto* = no extra input needed.
fields.AttackDataTable.AttackTransitionKind: Follow-up slots this move can chain into (combo tree). Up to 9 entries, None-padded; entries name combo nodes like NormalAttack_1, CursedEnergyAttack_1, ExtraAttack_1.
fields.AttackDataTable.AutoTransitionKind: Auto-combo follow-up: where a mashing player goes from here without precise timing. None = no auto progression.
fields.AttackDataTable.AutoTransitionKind_Curse: Auto-combo follow-up when the player is holding the cursed-energy modifier. None = same as the normal auto route.
fields.AttackDataTable.AutoComboFixedCursedEner: Forces the cursed-energy level during this auto-combo step. 0 = not forced (use the player's real level).
fields.AttackDataTable.CharacterFacial: Face override during the attack (e.g. Attack_01). None/Default = leave the face alone.
fields.AttackDataTable.CursedEnergy_Add: Cursed-energy gauge granted when this attack starts. Usually 0; positive values refund skills.
fields.AttackDataTable.CursedEnergyCalcType: How the CursedEnergy_Add value is treated: None = ignore it, CheckOnly = require the gauge without spending, Force = apply regardless.
fields.AttackDataTable.BlendInTime_Idle: Animation blend (seconds) when entering this move from idle. -1 = engine default; raise to smooth snappy transitions.
fields.AttackDataTable.BlendInTime_Fall: Animation blend (seconds) when entering this move while falling/airborne. -1 = engine default.
fields.AttackDataTable.ContinuousUseAttackVoice: Attack shout intensity (Weak through Finish, Projectile, Charge). Match it to the move or jabs will yell like ultimates.
fields.AttackDataTable.Id_ParallelAttack: Linked parallel/assist attack row (double-team or weapon-side hit). None = solo hit only.
fields.AttackDataTable.bSuperArmorEnabled: True = attacker armors through hits during this move (takes damage but no reaction).
fields.AttackDataTable.bHyperArmorEnabled: True = stronger armor tier during this move (shrugs off hits super armor cannot).
fields.AttackDataTable.TargetChangeType: When the lock-on target may switch during this move: never, the moment the attack activates, or always. Wrong choice makes moves whiff after a sidestep.
fields.AttackDataTable.bUpdateHomingLocation: True = keep re-aiming the homing point as the target moves. Disable for fixed-commitment lunges.
fields.AttackDataTable.bTargetOnlyHitAttackTran: True = follow-up cancels are only offered if the hit actually connected (whiffs end the string).
fields.AttackDataTable.bChangeLastHitNotTargetE: True = the final hit may strike a non-target (splash the last hit onto nearby enemies).
fields.AttackDataTable.AttackActionType: Move class: plain Attack, Charge (holdable), UnblockableAttack, or AroundAttack (area/crowd swing). Drives guard interaction and AI.
fields.AttackDataTable.AttackTiming: Wind-up delay (seconds) before the hit goes live. 0.1 is a fast jab; raise for slow heavies.
fields.AttackDataTable.DistanceDelayAttackTimin: Extra activation delay scaled by distance to the target. -1 = disabled; positive values make long-range hits arrive later.
fields.AttackDataTable.AttackAvoidType: Which defensive option cleanly beats this move (Guard, DodgeStep, AwayStep/Dash/Jump). Informs AI and counter design.
fields.AttackDataTable.SimpleDomainCounterRecei: How Simple Domain answers this move: only when the attack activates, or always. None = cannot be countered this way.
Delay (seconds) before the Simple Domain counter window opens. -1 = default timing.
fields.AttackSetDataTable.ID: Row ID. An AttackSet is a named bundle of Attack rows (a full string or stance) referenced from ActionDataTable slots.
fields.AttackSetDataTable.Id_Attack: Attack rows in this set, in order. Each entry must exist in AttackDataTable1..5 or the string has a dead link.
fields.AttackSetDataTable.AttackRangeType: Range class of the set: Short (brawler) or Long (zoner/projectile). Drives AI spacing and checklist grouping.
fields.AttackSetDataTable.bCursedEnergyAttack: True = this set is a cursed-energy (skill) string rather than a normal chain. Routes XP/voice/log buckets accordingly.
fields.AttackSetDataTable.bRecoverCursedEnergyD: True = firing this set does not regen cursed energy. Use for spammable skills you do not want to self-refund.
fields.AttackSetDataTable.Inherit_Inertia_Rate: How much ground momentum carries into the set (0 = stop dead, 1 = keep all speed). Keeps dash-attacks flowing.
fields.AttackSetDataTable.Inherit_Inertia_RateZ: How much vertical momentum carries in. Raise for dive attacks that should keep falling speed.
fields.ActionDataTable.ID: Row ID, one per fighter (CP_010 = Yuji ...). The moveset hub: every slot points at an AttackSet or movement row. To give a character a new string, point a slot here.
fields.ActionDataTable.Id_ActionBreakFall: Breakfall (ukemi) tuning row for this fighter. Controls which knockdowns can be teched and how fast.
fields.ActionDataTable.Id_ActionDash: Dash tuning row (costs, speeds, cancel windows) for this fighter.
fields.ActionDataTable.Id_ActionJump: Jump tuning row for this fighter.
fields.ActionDataTable.Id_ActionMove: Run/guard-movement tuning row for this fighter.
fields.ActionDataTable.Id_ActionStep: Sidestep/dodge tuning row for this fighter.
fields.ActionDataTable.Id_AttackSet_Normal_1: Ground normal string, stage 1 (first jab). Points at an AttackSetDataTable row.
fields.ActionDataTable.Id_AttackSet_Normal_1_1: Ground normal follow-up/branch off stage 1 (the _1_1 variant).
fields.ActionDataTable.Id_AttackSet_Normal_1_1_: Auto-combo (mash) version of the stage-1 follow-up.
Solo-mode auto-combo version of the stage-1 follow-up.
fields.ActionDataTable.Id_AttackSet_Normal_2_1_: Auto-combo version of the stage-2 follow-up.
fields.ActionDataTable.Id_AttackSet_Normal_3_1_: Auto-combo version of the stage-3 follow-up.
fields.ActionDataTable.Id_AttackSet_Normal_Air_: Air auto-combo version of the stage-1 follow-up.
Solo-mode air auto version of the stage-1 follow-up.
Air auto-combo version of the stage-2 follow-up.
Air auto-combo version of the stage-3 follow-up.
fields.ActionDataTable.Id_AttackSet_CursedEnerg: Skill slot 1 (ground). Array: successive presses/cancels of the skill.
Air skill slot 1. Array like the ground versions.
Air auto-combo version of air skill 2.
fields.ActionDataTable.Id_AttackSet_SuperCursed: Ultimate/super skill (ground). The big cinematic attack.
Aerial ultimate. Often mirrors the ground one with air-safe homing.
fields.ActionDataTable.Id_ExtraAttack_1: Extra/special attack 1 (stance, install, or character-gimmick move).
fields.CharacterBaseParameterDataTable.ID: Row ID, one per fighter (CP_010 ...). The stat block: HP, guard, reach, down meter.
fields.CharacterBaseParameterDataTable.HitPoint: Max HP in team modes. Yuji has 440; tanks push ~470+, glass cannons ~380.
Max HP in 1v1/solo mode. Usually mirrors HitPoint; split them to rebalance duels without touching teams.
fields.CharacterBaseParameterDataTable.AttackRa: Lock-on/engage range (Unreal units). ~1000-1250 vanilla; higher lets the AI and dash-attacks start from further out.
fields.CharacterBaseParameterDataTable.Guard_Mi: Minimum seconds a guard stays up once raised. 0.2 stops guard-flicker from being free.
fields.CharacterBaseParameterDataTable.GuardDur: Guard HP in team modes (~150). When Damage rows chew through it, a guard break opens the victim up.
Guard HP in solo mode. Split from the team value for duel balance.
Seconds after the last blocked hit before the guard meter starts refilling (~3).
Guard-meter refill per second once recovery starts (~15).
fields.CharacterBaseParameterDataTable.DownValu: Knockdown pool (usually 1000). Damage rows deal Down_Damage into it; full meter = crumple. Raise for combo sponges.
fields.CharacterBaseParameterDataTable.LargeCha: Extra knockdown recovery (seconds) for large/boss bodies. 0 = same as everyone else.
fields.CharacterCursedEnergyDataTable.ID: Row ID, one per fighter. Cursed-energy level ladder: thresholds to level up plus passive regen.
fields.CharacterCursedEnergyDataTable.LevelThre: XP needed for each level (4 entries: level 1-4). Yuji needs [100,200,300,400]; slower characters demand far more.
fields.CharacterCursedEnergyDataTable.Recover_W: Seconds after spending energy before passive regen resumes. 1.0-1.5 vanilla.
fields.CharacterCursedEnergyDataTable.Recover_S: Passive energy regen per second (75-95 vanilla). The main pacing knob for skill spam.
fields.CharacterCursedEnergyDataTable.Recover_W: Solo-mode multiplier for the regen delay. 1 = same as teams.
fields.CharacterCursedEnergyDataTable.Recover_S: Solo-mode multiplier for regen speed. 1 = same as teams.
fields.CharacterCursedEnergyDataTable.Add_Rate_: Solo-mode multiplier for all energy gains. Lower to slow ultimates in duels.
fields.CharacterDataTable.ID: Row ID, one per fighter. The hub row linking every component table (action, params, visuals, sound) for one character.
fields.CharacterDataTable.Id_Action: Moveset hub row (ActionDataTable). The single most important link: it decides every string this fighter can perform.
fields.CharacterDataTable.Id_CharacterAnimation: Animation-set row listing this fighter's montages. New Attack rows need their anims registered here (via CharacterAnimationDataTable).
fields.CharacterDataTable.Id_CharacterOperation: AI operation/stance voices row. Usually leave alone unless revoicing tactics.
fields.CharacterDataTable.Id_CharacterSpecialAt: Special/ultimate metadata row (damage links, domain expansion, name text).
fields.CharacterDataTable.Id_CharacterCamera: Camera framing row for this fighter's moves. Tweaks zoom/shake feel per character.
fields.CharacterDataTable.Id_CharacterEffect: Effect set row (hit sparks, auras) for this fighter.
fields.CharacterDataTable.Id_CharacterSound: Sound set row. Missing/unset entries = silent moves.
fields.CharacterDataTable.Id_CommandList: Movelist/pause-menu entry row. Needed for the move to show its inputs in-game.
fields.CharacterDataTable.ActionControllerType: Control scheme for this fighter (player, AI tiers). Wrong type = puppet or brain-dead AI.
fields.CharacterDataTable.AIType: Which AI brain drives this fighter (usually its own CP_* entry). Mismatching it borrows another fighter's habits.
fields.CharacterDataTable.CharacterGroup: Faction bucket (sorcerers, cursed spirits, ...). Drives teaming, targeting and some scaling.
fields.CharacterDataTable.CharacterPairGroup: Tag-team compatibility bucket. Decides legal partners.
fields.CharacterDataTable.DamageRate_AutoCombo: Damage multiplier for this fighter's auto-combo (mash) hits. Below 1 keeps mash honest.
fields.CharacterDataTable.AutoAttackDash_Distan: Distance at which auto-attack dash triggers. Higher = stickier gap-closing.
fields.CharacterDataTable.LinkComboCursedEnergy: Multiplier for energy XP earned in link/tag combos. Tunes partner synergy rewards.
fields.CharacterDataTable.PvEAllyWeights: AI pick-weight for this fighter as a PvE ally. 0 = never auto-picked.
fields.CharacterDataTable.Id_Character_Transfor: Transformation/awakening form row for this fighter. None = no install form.
fields.CharacterDataTable.Id_CharacterArcade: Arcade-mode metadata row (ladders, bonuses) for this fighter.
fields.CharacterDataTable.Id_CharacterCapture: Photo/capture-mode setup row. Cosmetic for the gallery, safe to ignore for balance.
fields.CharacterDataTable.Id_CharacterChat: Battle-chat bark set row. Flavor lines, no combat effect.
fields.CharacterDataTable.Id_CharacterDecal: Decal set row (marks, tattoos, ground stamps) for this fighter.
fields.CharacterDataTable.Id_CharacterSelect: Roster-placement row (CharacterSelectDataTable). Needed for the fighter to appear on select screens.
fields.CharacterDataTable.Id_CharacterShikigami: Shikigami companion rows (array). Empty/None = fights alone.
fields.CharacterDataTable.Id_CharacterTrap: Trap/planted-object rows (array) this fighter can deploy.
fields.CharacterDataTable.Id_CharacterUI: UI assets row (portraits, icons) for this fighter.
fields.CharacterDataTable.Id_CharacterUnique: Per-fighter unique/gimmick tuning rows (array). Character-specific mechanics live here.
fields.CharacterDataTable.Id_CharacterVariation: Costume/variation rows (array). Needed for alt outfits to load the right assets.
fields.CharacterDataTable.Id_GlossaryText_Name: Display-name text ID (glossary). Renaming here changes roster/movelist labels.
fields.CharacterDataTable.Id_GlossaryText_Story: Story-mode display-name text ID. Split so story aliases can differ from versus names.
fields.CharacterDataTable.Id_Item: Equippable-item row for this fighter (lobby/PvE loadouts).
fields.CharacterDataTable.AutoAimLimitAngleYaw: Horizontal auto-aim tolerance (degrees). Wider = stickier targeting.
fields.CharacterDataTable.AutoAimLimitAnglePitc: Vertical auto-aim tolerance (degrees). Wider tracks jumpers better.
fields.ActionMoveDataTable.ID: Row ID. Ground/run/guard movement feel: speeds, blends, inertia, lean.
fields.ActionMoveDataTable.Run_Speed_Start: Run speed at the start of the blend (Unreal units/sec).
fields.ActionMoveDataTable.Run_Speed_End: Run speed it settles to. Split start/end + InterpolateTime gives acceleration feel.
fields.ActionMoveDataTable.Run_InterpolateTime: Seconds to blend from run start speed to end speed. 0 = instant top speed.
fields.ActionMoveDataTable.Run_Blend_Exp: Curve exponent for the run-speed blend (~2 vanilla). Higher = faster early acceleration.
fields.ActionMoveDataTable.Run_EasingType: Easing curve for the run blend (None = linear).
fields.ActionMoveDataTable.Run_Inertia_Rate: Momentum kept while running (0 = stop on input release, 1 = ice-skate).
fields.ActionMoveDataTable.Run_Lean_Max: Max visual lean angle while running. Cosmetic, sells speed.
fields.ActionMoveDataTable.Run_Lean_Rate: How fast the lean reaches max. Higher = snappier tilt.
fields.ActionMoveDataTable.Run_Rotation_Rate: Turn responsiveness while running. Low = wide arcs, high = twitchy.
fields.ActionMoveDataTable.Run_Rotation_Time: How long the rotation assist applies.
fields.ActionMoveDataTable.Guard_Inertia_Rate: Momentum kept while guard-walking (ground). Low values make turtling ponderous.
fields.ActionMoveDataTable.GuardAir_Speed_Start: Air guard-drift speed at blend start.
fields.ActionMoveDataTable.GuardAir_Speed_End: Air guard-drift speed at blend end.
fields.ActionMoveDataTable.GuardAir_Interpolate: Seconds to blend air-guard drift speeds.
fields.ActionMoveDataTable.GuardAir_Blend_Exp: Curve exponent for the air-guard blend.
fields.ActionMoveDataTable.GuardAir_EasingType: Easing curve for the air-guard blend.
fields.ActionMoveDataTable.Landing_Inertia_Rate: Ground momentum kept on landing. High values let jump-ins slide into pressure.
fields.ActionMoveDataTable.Rigidity_Landing: Landing protection tier (None/Light/Normal/Heavy). Higher tiers ignore reactions on touchdown.
fields.ActionMoveDataTable.Foreground_Speed_Rat: Speed multiplier for foreground/background-plane movement segments.
fields.ActionMoveDataTable.Target_Speed_Rate: Strafe speed multiplier while locked on.
fields.ActionMoveDataTable.Target_Speed_Distanc: Distance band where the lock-on strafe rate applies.
fields.ActionMoveDataTable.ParallelAttack_Speed: Speed multiplier while a parallel/assist attack is active.
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.ID: Row ID. Steering brain for one attack's lunge: how far it reaches, how hard it tracks, and whether it teleports (warp) instead of running.
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.ActionHomingType: Steering mode: None (straight), EightWay (8-direction), Curve (bend), Warp/WarpMove (teleport to the target). Warps ignore obstacles but need sane distances.
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.HomingDistance: Max lock-on reach (Unreal units). Beyond this the move whiffs instead of sliding forward.
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.Homing_Time_Min: Minimum seconds the homing steers. Guarantees at least a short track-in.
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.Homing_Time_Max: Maximum seconds homing stays active. Caps runaway cross-screen slides.
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.Homing_Delay_Time: Delay (seconds) before homing kicks in. Small delays let the startup play before the lunge.
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.bIgnoreHomingRange: True = lunge regardless of range (will chase across the stage). Use for supers, not jabs.
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.Speed_End: Lunge speed at the end of the window. End < Start gives a decelerating dash-in.
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.Speed_InterpolateT: Seconds to blend from start to end lunge speed.
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.Speed_EasingType: Easing curve for the lunge-speed blend.
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.Rotation_Speed_Sta: Turn rate at the start of homing (degrees/sec-ish). High values stick to sidesteppers.
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.Rotation_Speed_End: Turn rate at the end of homing. Dropping it lets late sidesteps escape.
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.Rotation_Speed_Eas: Easing curve for the turn-rate blend.
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.Rotation_Angle_Lim: Max total turning (degrees) allowed during homing. Caps 180s from looking broken.
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.Rotation_Yaw: Base yaw offset (degrees) for the lunge direction.
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.AngleZ: Vertical tolerance (degrees/units) for tracking airborne targets.
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.RangeZ_Upper: How far above the attacker homing still connects.
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.RangeZ_Lower: How far below the attacker homing still connects.
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.Inertia_Rate: Momentum preserved into the homing move (0-1). Keeps dash-attacks flowing.
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.CharacterAnimation: Movement animation during the homing (dash-in run). Falls back to the Attack row's anim if empty.
Animation when homing fails to reach (whiff slide).
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.WeaponAnimation: Weapon anim during homing. None = body anim covers it.
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.WarpDistance: Teleport distance for Warp types. Overshooting strands the attacker behind the target, so keep it near HomingDistance.
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.WarpTargetDistance: Offset kept from the target after a warp (stops inside the victim's model at 0; small positive values land at strike range).
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.WarpDirectionAdjus: Horizontal aim tweak (degrees) for the warp exit.
Vertical aim tweak for the warp exit.
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.WarpAdjustTargetSi: How the warp exit is predicted (static vs simulated target). Simulated tracks dashing victims better.
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.bSuperArmorEnabled: Grants super armor during the lunge.
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.bHyperArmorEnabled: Grants hyper armor during the lunge.
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.bFollowGroundEnabl: True = stick to the ground height during the lunge (no floating over ledges).
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.bExternalForceEnab: True = apply the ExternalForce push defined below during the lunge.
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.Distance_Correct: Fine-tune added to the homing reach check (units). Positive forgives slightly-out-of-range lunges.
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.ExternalForceStren: Push strength at the start of the lunge.
Push strength at the end of the window.
Seconds to blend the push strength from start to end.
Easing curve for the push-strength blend.
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.ExternalForceGravi: Gravity correction applied to pushed bodies. Keeps shoved victims from floating or face-planting.
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.FollowGroundCheckD: How far down to probe for ground while ground-following (units).
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.FollowGroundFallGr: Gravity applied while settling back to the ground during a follow-ground lunge.
fields.ActionHomingDataTable.FollowGroundIgnore: Step height ignored while following the ground (small ledges are smoothed over below this).
fields.ActionDashDataTable.ID: Row ID. Dash feel and economy: gauge costs, speeds, cancel windows, armor tiers.
fields.ActionDashDataTable.Gauge: Dash-gauge max in team modes. Dash actions spend from this pool.
fields.ActionDashDataTable.GaugeRecoverWaitTime: Seconds after dashing before refill resumes.
fields.ActionDashDataTable.Dash_GaugeConsumeBeg: Gauge spent the moment a ground dash starts.
fields.ActionDashDataTable.DashAir_GaugeConsume: Gauge spent the moment an air dash starts.
fields.ActionDashDataTable.NormalDash_Speed_S: Ground dash speed, short tier. S/M/E are distance tiers (tap vs held vs extended).
fields.ActionDashDataTable.NormalDash_GaugeCons: Gauge spent on a ground dash.
fields.ActionDashDataTable.NormalDash_CancelInp: How early (seconds) into a ground dash a cancel input is accepted. Lower = more committal.
fields.ActionDashDataTable.NormalDash_Minimum_T: Minimum dash duration before it can end. Prevents teleport-feeling micro-dashes.
fields.ActionDashDataTable.NormalDash_Interpola: Blend time for the medium-tier dash curve.
Blend time for the extended-tier dash curve.
fields.ActionDashDataTable.NormalDash_Lean_Max: Max visual lean during a ground dash.
fields.ActionDashDataTable.NormalDash_Lean_Rate: How fast the dash lean kicks in.
fields.ActionDashDataTable.NormalDash_Rotation_: Turn rate during a ground dash.
fields.ActionDashDataTable.NormalDash_GaugeCons: Delay before the dash gauge cost is charged.
fields.ActionDashDataTable.HomingDashAir_Speed_: Air homing-dash speed, short tier (tracking dash at an airborne target).
fields.ActionDashDataTable.HomingDashAir_GaugeC: Gauge cost of an air homing dash.
fields.ActionDashDataTable.HomingDashAir_Cancel: Cancel window for air homing dashes.
fields.ActionDashDataTable.NormalDashAir_Speed_: Air dash speed, short tier. Air dashes trade gauge for positioning; keep costs real or air camping takes over.
fields.ActionDashDataTable.NormalDashAir_GaugeC: Gauge cost of an air dash.
fields.ActionDashDataTable.NormalDashAir_Gravit: Gravity applied during the air dash. Low values hover; high values dive.
fields.ActionDashDataTable.NormalDashAir_Turn_D: Delay before turning responds mid air-dash.
fields.ActionDashDataTable.Rigidity_DashEnd: Protection tier at dash end. Begin/end splits let the startup be safe and the recovery punishable.
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.ID: Row ID. Jump physics: heights, airtime, drift, and landing protection.
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.Jump_Speed_Start: Vertical launch speed (units/sec). The main jump-height knob.
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.Jump_Speed_End: Vertical speed it eases toward. Lower values float, higher values slam down.
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.Jump_Blend_Exp: Curve exponent for the jump blend.
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.Jump_XY_Speed: Horizontal drift speed during the jump.
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.Jump_Overtime: Max extra airtime (seconds) the jump can sustain.
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.Jump_Minimum_Time: Minimum airtime before landing is allowed.
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.Jump_Inertia_Rate: Ground momentum kept into the jump (0-1). High values enable running leaps.
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.Jump_Inherit_Inertia: Share of pre-jump velocity inherited vertically-ish. Pairs with Inertia_Rate for dash-jump flow.
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.Fall_Gravity: Downward acceleration once the jump tops out. Higher = snappier landings.
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.JumpAir_InterpolateT: Blend time for the double-jump curve.
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.JumpAir_Overtime: Max extra airtime for the double jump.
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.JumpAir_CancelInput_: Earliest cancel out of the double jump. Gates air-action speed.
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.JumpAir_Inertia_Rate: Momentum kept into the double jump.
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.JumpAir_Inherit_Iner: Inherited momentum share for the double jump.
Vertical share for the double jump.
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.DashJump_Speed_Start: Dash-jump vertical launch speed (sprint into jump).
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.DashJump_Interpolate: Blend time for the dash-jump curve.
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.DashJump_XY_Speed: Dash-jump horizontal speed. The gap-closer knob.
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.DashJump_Overtime: Max extra airtime for dash jumps.
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.DashJump_Inertia_Rat: Dash momentum kept into the jump.
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.RunJump_InterpolateT: Blend time for the running-jump curve.
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.RunJump_Blend_Exp: Curve exponent for the running jump.
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.RunJump_Overtime: Max extra airtime for running jumps.
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.RunJump_Inertia_Rate: Run momentum kept into the jump.
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.RunJumpAir_Interpola: Blend time for the air running-jump curve.
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.RunJumpAir_Blend_Exp: Curve exponent for the air running jump.
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.RunJumpAir_XY_Speed: Air running-jump horizontal speed. The air gap-closer knob.
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.RunJumpAir_Overtime: Max extra airtime for air running jumps.
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.RunJumpAir_Inertia_R: Momentum kept into the air running jump.
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.RunJumpAir_Inherit_I: Inherited share for air running jumps.
Vertical share for air running jumps.
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.BounceUp_Interpolate: Blend time for the bounce curve.
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.Rigidity_JumpBegin: Protection tier when a ground jump starts.
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.Rigidity_JumpAirBegi: Protection tier when the double jump starts.
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.Rigidity_RunJumpBegi: Protection tier when a running jump starts.
fields.ActionJumpDataTable.Rigidity_DashJumpBeg: Protection tier when a dash jump starts.
fields.ActionStepDataTable.ID: Row ID. Sidestep/dodge: distance, cooldown, and tracking evasion.
fields.ActionStepDataTable.Step_Speed_Start: Ground-step speed at start (units/sec). The distance knob together with Step_Time.
fields.ActionStepDataTable.Step_Speed_End: Ground-step speed at end. End near 0 for a crisp stop.
fields.ActionStepDataTable.Step_Blend_Exp: Curve exponent for the step blend.
fields.ActionStepDataTable.Step_Time: Total step duration (seconds). Speed x time = distance.
fields.ActionStepDataTable.Step_HomingInvalidat: Tracking evasion: homing within this range loses lock during the step. Higher = stronger dodge.
fields.ActionStepDataTable.StepEnd_PlayRate: Animation playback rate at step end. >1 hurries the recovery pose.
fields.ActionStepDataTable.StepAir_InterpolateT: Blend time for the air step.
fields.ActionStepDataTable.StepAir_Blend_Exp: Curve exponent for the air step.
fields.ActionStepDataTable.StepAir_EasingType: Easing curve for the air step.
fields.ActionStepDataTable.StepAir_Inertia_Rate: Momentum kept into the air step.
fields.ActionStepDataTable.CoolTime: Cooldown (seconds) before the next step. The spam-control knob for dodges.
fields.ActionBreakFallDataTable.ID: Row ID. Breakfall (air-tech/ukemi): which knockdowns can be teched and the resulting invulnerability.
fields.ActionBreakFallDataTable.Blow_CancelInpu: Tech window (seconds) after a standard blow launch. Larger = more forgiving escapes.
fields.ActionBreakFallDataTable.BlowSmall_Cance: Tech window after a small blow.
fields.ActionBreakFallDataTable.BlowLarge_Cance: Tech window after a large blow. Keep finishers tight (small values) so enders actually end.
fields.ActionBreakFallDataTable.Down_CancelInpu: Tech window after a knockdown slam.
fields.ActionBreakFallDataTable.Invincible_Time: Invulnerability (seconds) granted after a successful tech. Too high makes teching strictly better than holding the combo.
fields.ParallelAttackDataTable.ID: Row ID. Paired/assist attack visuals (double-team strikes, weapon-side swings) referenced from Attack rows.
fields.ParallelAttackDataTable.CharacterAnimati: Body animation for the parallel/assist swing.
Lower-body override during the parallel swing. Lets the assist move while the torso plays its own anim.
fields.BuffDebuffDataTable.ID: Row ID. Status effect instance: which buff/debuff plus its tuning values.
fields.BuffDebuffDataTable.BuffDebuff: Which status this row applies (character passives, slows, gauge mods, adaptation stacks). CP_* entries are character-specific passives.
fields.BuffDebuffDataTable.bEffectEnabled: True = play the status visual/audio. Disable for invisible/system-only modifiers.
fields.BuffDebuffDataTable.FloatValue: Tuning numbers for the status (rates, ticks, caps). Meaning depends on the BuffDebuff type; sample vanilla rows of the same type before editing.
fields.EffectDataTable.ID: Row ID. Visual projectile/hit-spark definition: asset, lifespan, collision, and which Damage it deals.
fields.EffectDataTable.FileName_BP: Effect blueprint asset path spawned for this row.
fields.EffectDataTable.Id_Damage: Damage row dealt when this effect connects. The Effect -> Damage link is how projectiles hurt.
fields.EffectDataTable.EffectType: Effect class: None (plain visual) or Projectile (travels and hits).
fields.EffectDataTable.Life_Time: Seconds before the effect despawns. 0 = very brief / immediate.
fields.EffectDataTable.Life_Distance: Max travel distance before despawn. Caps stray projectiles.
fields.EffectDataTable.Life_Hit: Max hits before despawn. >1 enables pierce.
fields.EffectDataTable.Collision_Delay_Time: Delay (seconds) before the effect's hitbox activates. Lets muzzle flashes clear before the projectile goes live.
fields.EffectDataTable.Collision_Priority: Hit-resolution priority when volumes overlap. Higher wins ties.
fields.EffectDataTable.bThroughCharacterEnabled: True = passes through fighters (no collision with bodies).
fields.EffectDataTable.ThroughDestructibleObjec: How stage destructibles are treated: blocked, pass-through, or conditional.
fields.EffectDataTable.Id_EffectMove: Movement brain row for travelling effects. Controls homing arcs for projectiles.
fields.EffectDataTable.ExternalForce_Strength: Push force applied by this effect.
fields.EffectDataTable.PoolCount: How many instances are pre-pooled. Raise for spammy effects to avoid hitches; costs memory.
fields.CameraShakeDataTable.ID: Row ID. Screen-shake recipe referenced from Damage rows (attacker + receiver slots).
fields.CameraShakeDataTable.OscillationBlendInT: Ramp-up time. Snappy hits use near-0; rising rumbles fade in.
fields.CameraShakeDataTable.OscillationBlendOut: Ramp-down time. Longer tails feel heavier.
fields.CameraShakeDataTable.RotOscillation_Pitc: Vertical shake size (degrees). The main heaviness knob.
Vertical shake speed. High = buzz, low = sway.
fields.GlobalCorrectDataTable.ID: Row ID (single Default row). Global damage/energy/rigidity multipliers: the game-wide balance levers.
fields.GlobalCorrectDataTable.Combo_Base: Base combo-scaling multiplier applied as combos grow. Below 1 = longer combos deal less per hit.
fields.GlobalCorrectDataTable.Combo_Min: Floor for combo scaling. Damage per hit never scales below this.
fields.GlobalCorrectDataTable.Combo_Damage: Extra scaling for damage-typed hits inside combos.
fields.GlobalCorrectDataTable.Combo_Blow: Scaling for blow-launch hits in combos.
fields.GlobalCorrectDataTable.Combo_BlowSmall: Scaling for small-blow hits in combos.
fields.GlobalCorrectDataTable.Combo_BlowLarge: Scaling for large-blow hits in combos.
fields.GlobalCorrectDataTable.Combo_Down: Scaling for knockdown hits in combos.
fields.GlobalCorrectDataTable.Combo_Casual: Scaling for casual/cinematic hits in combos.
fields.GlobalCorrectDataTable.SuperArmor_Damage: Damage multiplier vs super-armored targets (1 = normal).
fields.GlobalCorrectDataTable.HyperArmor_Damage: Damage multiplier vs hyper-armored targets (0.5 vanilla = armored targets take half).
fields.GlobalCorrectDataTable.CursedEnergyExp_B: Base tweak added to energy-XP gains. Negative values slow the whole energy economy.
fields.GlobalCorrectDataTable.CursedEnergyExp_L: Per-level adjustment to energy XP. Negative slows high-level snowballing.
fields.GlobalCorrectDataTable.Rigidity_JumpBegi: Landing/jump-start protection multipliers per tier (array of 3: light/normal/heavy contexts). Below 1 softens that rigidity globally.
fields.GlobalCorrectDataTable.Rigidity_RunJumpB: Global rigidity multipliers for running-jump starts.
fields.GlobalCorrectDataTable.Rigidity_DashJump: Global rigidity multipliers for dash-jump starts.
fields.GlobalCorrectDataTable.Rigidity_JumpAirB: Global rigidity multipliers for double-jump starts.
fields.GlobalCorrectDataTable.Rigidity_DashBegi: Global rigidity multipliers at dash start.
fields.GlobalCorrectDataTable.Rigidity_DashEnd: Global rigidity multipliers at dash end (recovery punishability).
fields.GlobalCorrectDataTable.Rigidity_DashAirB: Global rigidity multipliers at air-dash start.
fields.GlobalCorrectDataTable.Rigidity_DashAirE: Global rigidity multipliers at air-dash end.
fields.GlobalDataTable.ID: Row ID (single Default-ish row). Global match/physics feel: timers, bounds, slow-mo, guard windows.
fields.GlobalDataTable.TimeLimit: Match time limits per mode (array, seconds).
fields.GlobalDataTable.DownValue_Recover_Time: Seconds before the knockdown meter starts draining.
fields.GlobalDataTable.DamageGravity: Global extra gravity on launched victims. Stacks with per-hit DamageGravity.
fields.GlobalDataTable.JustGuard_Time: Parry window (seconds) for a Just Guard. Wider = friendlier parries.
fields.GlobalDataTable.JustGuard_HitSlow_Attack: Hitstop on the attacker when their hit is just-guarded.
fields.GlobalDataTable.JustGuard_HitSlow_Receiv: Hitstop on the parrying defender (usually tiny, so parries feel crisp).
fields.GlobalDataTable.JustGuard_HitSlow_Time_A: Duration of the attacker's just-guard freeze.
fields.GlobalDataTable.JustGuard_HitSlow_Time_R: Duration of the defender's just-guard freeze.
fields.GlobalDataTable.GroundBoundSlowRate: Time-scale during ground bounces (lower = more dramatic slow-mo).
fields.GlobalDataTable.GroundBoundSlowTime: How long the ground-bounce slow-mo lasts.
fields.GlobalDataTable.WallBoundSlowTime: How long the wall-splat slow-mo lasts.
fields.GlobalDataTable.LinkCombo_CursedEnergyEx: Bonus energy XP for completing a link combo.
fields.CharacterSpecialAttackDataTable.ID: Row ID, one per fighter. Ultimate/tag-combo metadata: which Damage rows fire and which domain expansion plays.
fields.CharacterSpecialAttackDataTable.Id_Damag: Damage row for the solo (1v1) super. This is the hit that actually KOs.
Damage row for the tag-team super.
fields.CharacterSpecialAttackDataTable.Id_Domai: Domain-expansion row played with the super. None = no domain overlay.
fields.CharacterSpecialAttackDataTable.Id_Gloss: Name text ID shown for the super (glossary/announce text).
fields.CharacterSpecialAttackDataTable.RankingR: Which ranked stat this super feeds (score/leaderboard bucket).
fields.CharacterSpecialAttackDataTable.bMultiHi: True = the solo super hits multiple times (multi-tick cinematic) instead of one burst.
fields.CharacterAnimationDataTable.ID: Row ID, one per fighter-set. Animation registry: pairs asset filenames with lookup keys the Attack/Homing rows reference.
fields.CharacterAnimationDataTable.Filename: Animation asset paths, parallel to Key. A wrong path here = T-pose on the moves using it.
fields.CharacterAnimationDataTable.Key: Lookup keys (e.g. AttackA_01_01) referenced by CharacterAnimation fields elsewhere.
fields.CharacterSelectDataTable.ID: Row ID, one per fighter. Roster placement: where this fighter sits on select screens.
fields.CharacterSelectDataTable.PlacementIndex: Main-roster grid position. Gaps or duplicates overlap portraits.
fields.CharacterSelectDataTable.VisualLobbyPlac: Lobby/avatar-screen position. Split from the battle roster so events can reorder one without the other.
fields.CharacterSelectDataTable.bUseListItemLef: True = indent this entry in list-style selectors ( DLC / extra-fighter grouping).
fields.CharacterOperationDataTable.ID: Row ID, one per fighter. AI tactic voices: barks for each operation stance, plus hear-responses.
fields.CharacterOperationDataTable.Id_Voice_Nor: Voice line for the Normal stance.
fields.CharacterOperationDataTable.Id_Voice_Ons: Voice line when the AI goes aggressive.
fields.CharacterOperationDataTable.Id_Voice_Rec: Heard/reply bark when an ally calls Normal.
Reply bark for an ally's Onslaught call.
Reply bark for an ally's Cooperation call.
Reply bark for an ally's Carefully call.

EGameAttackType.None: No attack class. Utility/system rows that should skip attack buckets.
EGameAttackType.BindingVows: System/binding-vow hit (scripted, e.g. unkillable-flagged). Unblockable by design.

EGameDamageType.None: No reaction. Hit registers with no victim animation (stealth/system).
EGameDamageType.Normal: Standard standing reaction. The default for jabs and pokes.
EGameDamageType.NormalAir: Airborne-standard reaction. Juggles instead of grounding.
EGameDamageType.Down: Knockdown. Victim hits the floor and must tech or rise.
EGameDamageType.Blow: Launch. Sends the victim flying for combo extensions.
EGameDamageType.BlowSmall: Short launch (pop-up). Keeps the victim close for pressure.
EGameDamageType.BlowSpin: Spinning launch. Long, stylish juggle arc.
EGameDamageType.CentipedeRestraintFall: Centipede restraint ending in a slam.
EGameDamageType.SimpleDomainCounterStun: Stun from a Simple Domain counter.
EGameDamageType.ProjectionSorceryBlow: Projection freeze ending in a launch.
EGameDamageType.TagComboBlow: Tag-combo reaction ending in a launch.
EGameDamageType.TagComboCentipedeRestraint: Tag variant of the centipede restraint.
EGameDamageType.TagComboProjectionSorcery: Tag variant of the projection freeze.
EGameDamageType.TagComboProjectionSorceryBlow: Tag projection freeze ending in a launch.

EGameDamageKind.Melee: Direct strike (fist, weapon, body). Standard hit interactions.
EGameDamageKind.Projectile: Detached travelling hit (via Effect rows). Has life, range and pierce rules.
EGameDamageKind.Throwing: Grab-like / thrown interaction. Beats guards that stop strikes.

EGameDamageDirectionType.None: No directional launch. Victim reacts in place.
EGameDamageDirectionType.AttackerDirection: Launch relative to where the attacker faces.
EGameDamageDirectionType.ReceiverDirection: Launch relative to where the victim faces (back-turned hits fly oddly on purpose).
EGameDamageDirectionType.AttackerToReceiver: Launch along the line from attacker to victim. The reliable default for straight hits.
EGameDamageDirectionType.ActorDirection: Launch relative to the spawned actor (effect) facing.
EGameDamageDirectionType.ActorToReceiver: Launch along the line from the effect actor to the victim. For placed traps/zones.
EGameDamageDirectionType.MovementDirection: Launch along the victim's own motion. Extends runners instead of stopping them.

EGameDamageAdaptType.None: Never feeds adaptation. The safe default for most hits.
EGameDamageAdaptType.CursedEnergyAttack_1: Feeds the skill-1 adaptation bucket (Mahoraga-style resistance grows).

EGameAttackTransitionType.None: No cancel. The move always plays out.
EGameAttackTransitionType.InputHit: Cancel on any hit connect with an extra input. The core combo-link rule.
EGameAttackTransitionType.InputHitWithoutGuard: Cancel on hit, but not when guarded. Blocked strings end here.
EGameAttackTransitionType.InputHitWithoutJustGuard: Cancel on hit or normal guard, but a Just Guard shuts the door (rewards parries).
EGameAttackTransitionType.Input: Cancel with input regardless of contact (whiff-cancelable). Makes strings very slippery.
EGameAttackTransitionType.InputTiming: Cancel only with well-timed input. The execution-test gate.
EGameAttackTransitionType.AutoHit: Auto-continues on hit with no extra input (mash-friendly).
EGameAttackTransitionType.AutoHitWithoutGuard: Auto-continues on hit; blocked hits stop the auto string.
EGameAttackTransitionType.OnGround: Continues only while grounded. Air contact breaks the route.

EGameAttackTransitionKind.None: Empty combo slot (padding in the 9-entry array).
EGameAttackTransitionKind.NormalAttack_1_1_Auto: Auto route into the stage-1 follow-up.
EGameAttackTransitionKind.NormalAttack_2_1_Auto: Auto route into the stage-2 follow-up.
EGameAttackTransitionKind.NormalAttack_3_Auto: Auto route into the ground ender.
EGameAttackTransitionKind.NormalAttack_3_1_Auto: Auto route off the ground ender.
EGameAttackTransitionKind.SuperCursedEnergyAttack: Cancel into the ultimate. Gate this tightly or every jab confirms into super.

EGameAttackActionType.UnblockableAttack: Cannot be guarded (pairs with Damage.bIgnoreGuard). Telegraph it or players will riot.
EGameAttackActionType.AroundAttack: Area/crowd swing. Catches nearby enemies, not just the locked target.

EGameAttackAvoidType.None: No intended counter. Hard to avoid by design (use sparingly).
EGameAttackAvoidType.Guard: Holding guard beats it. Standard for strikes.
EGameAttackAvoidType.AwayDashJump: Back-dash into jump beats it (escapes high/low mix).

EGameAttackRangeType.Short: Brawler range. Wants to be close; AI pushes in.

EGameHitTargetType.EnemyOnly: Hurts enemies only. The default for attacks.
EGameHitTargetType.All: Hits everyone, including the attacker's own team. For wild zone/ultimate hits.

EGameHitEffectLocationType.ImpactPoint: Spawn exactly where the bodies met. Best for sparks.
EGameHitEffectLocationType.Receiver: Spawn on the victim (follows them through the reaction).
EGameHitEffectLocationType.HitComponent: Spawn on the struck body part/component.

EGameHitEffectDirection.None: No directional facing for the effect.
EGameHitEffectDirection.HitNormal: Face along the impact normal (classic spark).
EGameHitEffectDirection.ActorDirection: Face where the spawned actor looks.

EGameEasingType.EaseOut: Fast start, slow finish (decelerating lunges land softly).
EGameEasingType.EaseInOut: Smooth both ends. The natural-feeling default for movement.

EGameActionHomingType.None: Straight line. No steering; whiffs if the target moved.
EGameActionHomingType.EightWay: 8-direction steering. Forgiving lunges for fast strings.
EGameActionHomingType.Warp: Teleport to the target. Ignores distance but can look abrupt without matching anims.
EGameActionHomingType.WarpMove: Teleport then keep moving (warp with momentum). For pass-through strikes.

EGameActionRigidityType.Heavy: Ignores heavy reactions. Near-unstoppable startup; keep windows short.

EGameTargetChangeType.None: Never retarget mid-move. Committed to the original victim.
EGameTargetChangeType.AttackActivate: May switch target the moment the attack goes live.
EGameTargetChangeType.Always: Continuously re-acquires the best target. For crowd/area moves.

EGameCursedEnergyCalcType.None: Ignore the CursedEnergy_Add value on this row.
EGameCursedEnergyCalcType.CheckOnly: Require the gauge amount without spending it (gate the move, keep the meter).
EGameCursedEnergyCalcType.Force: Apply the energy change regardless of costs/gates.

EGameSimpleDomainCounterReceiveType.None: Cannot be answered by Simple Domain.
EGameSimpleDomainCounterReceiveType.AttackActivate: Counterable the moment the attack activates.

EGameCharacterFacial.Damage: Pain face (usually set by the damage system, not hand-authored).
EGameCharacterFacial.Attack_01: Battle-cry face for strikes. The standard attack override.

EGameCharacterDamageVoiceType.None: Silent (tanks the hit stoically or the sound is handled elsewhere).
EGameCharacterDamageVoiceType.Weak: Light grunt. For jabs and chips.
EGameCharacterDamageVoiceType.Heavy: Big scream. For launchers and heavies.
EGameCharacterDamageVoiceType.LargeHeavy: Maximum scream. For supers and wall splats.
